### A Call to Return Home (Acts 3:19) - Your Daily Bible Verse - July 9
Author: Becca Stevens
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/a-call-to-return-home-bible-study-minute-july-3-2018.html
Passage: Acts 3:19
Points:
- No person or failure is ever beyond redemption or God's love.
- Spiritual and emotional healing begins when we honestly repent of our wrongdoing.
- Biblical repentance means turning back and returning home to God's presence.
- A humble posture of repentance paves the way for restored relationships with others.
- Acknowledging past harm opens the door to lasting freedom and reconciliation.
